Definition: of Hebrew origin (H3383); the Jordanes (i.e. Jarden), a river of Palestine:--Jordan.
BiblicalUsage: The Jordan is the river where Israel crossed in and John baptized. In Matthew 3:6 the people are baptized of John in Jordan, confessing their sins, in Mark 1:5 all the land of Judea goes out to him and is baptized in the river, and in John 1:28 these things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the Jordan is the river of new beginnings: Israel entered the land through it, and the crowds went down into it to be washed clean.
